evals.prompt: Using RFProteina, generate a single short monomer design from the monomer benchmark. Run only the monomer-short example, one replicate, into ./runs/gen_eval, and confirm an annotated CIF is produced.
evals.expected_output: A successful preflight and one monomer-short generation using the configured release checkpoints, producing at least one annotated CIF under ./runs/gen_eval without refolding metrics.
assertions: Recognizes this as the unconditional-generation task and uses data/benchmarks/monomer
Runs rfd4-generate inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/gen_eval
Uses the release checkpoint pair selected by configs/inference.yaml without a checkpoint override
Does not enable any *_refolding metrics tag (no container required for plain generation)
